cells.gaps: No source from the last three years has the government both saying digital transformation must be paid for from the country's own resources and acting on it: no fund, levy or assigned tax is shown created, collecting or paying.
cells.note: Parliament approved about EGP 23.3 billion for the ICT ministry in 2026/27 against EGP 19.69 billion the year before (EGY-007), so the money rose. The fall in public ICT investment for 2025/26 (EGY-006) is of the budget before and not the ministry's vote.
